title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Returns and the Credit Builder Early-Closure Returned-Fee Relief
content:
The relief share of the early-closure returned-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows when a payment on the borrower's Larkspur FlexLine was also returned recently. The returns are read from the borrower's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit ledger: its returned-payment entries and their dates.

## FlexLine returns

When a payment on the borrower's Larkspur FlexLine was returned less than one whole calendar month before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month one month earlier falls outside), the same-event addition is added; when none was returned in that month but one was returned less than three whole calendar months before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month three months earlier falls outside), the quarter addition; otherwise nothing is added for the FlexLine.

| Latest FlexLine payment return | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| within the 1 whole calendar month before today | same-event addition: 0.2 (20 percentage points) |
| within the 3 whole calendar months, not within the 1 month | quarter addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| none within the 3 months | nothing |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

Today 15 August: a FlexLine return dated 16 July counts for the same-event addition; one dated 15 July does not, but counts for the quarter addition; one dated 15 May counts for neither.
